title: Chapter 621
text:
The rendezvous point was in another Star System in Colton, very far away from the Garton Star System. Han Xiao piloted Risda's body and arrived at the rendezvous planet.

This was an uninhabited planet with a serial number. When the Blacklight Stealth arrived at the rendezvous point, there were already many spaceships parked on the ground. The crowd was waiting for orders, and they all looked up at the newcomer.

The spaceship landed, and Han Xiao walked out of the hatch. He casually looked around and saw two people with Grade A life force. They seemed to be the two leaders, but they did not look familiar. They each led a group of people, and there were two organizations in total.

"Black Star from the Garton Star System? I've heard of him. "

"That guy is here too."

"He didn't bring those Immortal Mercenaries?"

Everyone present stared at Han Xiao with surprise and started discussing among themselves.

A member of the Amethyst Civilization walked out of the spaceship and came before Han Xiao. "Welcome, Black Star. I'm the person in charge of this operation, Secret Service Section 4, Level 3 External Affairs Envoy, Dottle."

"Hello." Han Xiao nodded and asked curiously, "Where's Ralph?"

Dottle's expression turned serious. "His Excellency Ralph's rank is very high. I'm his subordinate, so he doesn't need to be personally in charge of this operation."

Ralph's rank in the Amethyst Civilization was not low, but Han Xiao did not know that among the people involved in this operation, he was the only one who was personally invited by Ralph. The others only contacted Dottle.

The reason Han Xiao enjoyed such special treatment was because he had participated in the Tyrant's Party before. In Ralph's eyes, Black Star was a member of the upper circle, so he personally asked about this small operation that did not need him to be in charge to show how important it was.

"This is a three-way operation. Let me introduce you to the other two."

Dottle led Han Xiao and introduced the leaders of the other two organizations.

"This is Jayne, a powerful Esper. Everyone calls him 'Seaquake' … This is Gadeli, nicknamed 'Hundred Revolving Cannon'. He's a Mechanic like you, a Gunner."

The two of them sized up Han Xiao before politely shaking hands.

Jayne and Gadeli were well-equipped, especially Gadeli. The combat suit he was wearing was made of super-nano materials. Han Xiao could tell at a glance that it had a powerful transformation function. This guy was a Gunner, so he might be able to transform his trump card into a combat suit and wear it.

Han Xiao had never heard of them before. He asked Philip to search for them on Baidu and found out that they were not registered mercenaries but small private armed forces that had only been formed a few years ago and were quite small.

Speaking of which, the Black Star Army had only been established for a few years, but the speed of its rise was extremely shocking.

In the universe, the number of such organizations was only second to mercenary groups. They were established for various reasons, but they could mainly be divided into two categories. First, they were private armies that had their own goals and did not accept employment.

The second type was similar to mercenaries, but they did not accept public employment like normal mercenaries. They only accepted large private orders or looked for a long-term partner. They did not belong to the mercenary industry, and the restrictions on the members of an organization were much higher than that of a mercenary group. The Bloodshed Land was this type.

Generally speaking, as long as the organizer had money and strength, it was very easy to form a private armed force. The strength of the leader was the ceiling of a private armed force. Only Calamity Grades had the qualifications to dominate an area. Jayne and Gadeli were such organizations. They were mainly active in the more distant Star Systems, so their name had not reached Han Xiao's ears. Instead, they had all heard of Han Xiao's name.

This time, Jayne suddenly spoke with a doubtful tone. "You came alone?"

"I alone am enough."

Han Xiao smiled. Because this was an emergency mission, he did not waste time gathering people.

Jayne and Gadeli looked at each other, and joy flashed in their eyes.

They were new organizations, and this joint operation was a good opportunity to come into contact with the Amethyst Civilization. In their eyes, this was a competition to fight for a long-term cooperation with the Amethyst Civilization. They were competitors, so they had to perform well.

Originally, when they saw Black Star, their hearts skipped a beat. If Black Star had brought his Indestructible Army, the two of them would not have been able to compete at all.

However, with Black Star coming alone, they could not help but heave a sigh of relief. They felt that they had a chance to perform.

After a round of introductions, Dottle took out the star map and explained the operation steps.

"We're currently in Star Zone 3 of the Thousand Lights Star System, and the target is in Star Zone 7. According to their movement trajectory, we can intercept them in Star Zone 9 …

"We have three Calamity Grade Supers and forty-four battleships. The target has sixty-five battleships, but some of them are disguised civilian spaceships, so the enemy's actual combat strength will be lower. We don't know the combat strength of the enemy's personnel. They entered the Colton Star Cluster from the desolate universe belt and did not go through identity checks. They have not stopped to resupply so far."

Everyone nodded. The Amethyst Civilization's intelligence network covered the entire Star Cluster. They only needed to rush over. They had three Calamity Grade Supers, so the enemy's advantage of merely twenty battleships was meaningless.

"It's just a small fleet …" Han Xiao raised his brows. He originally thought that it would be a very difficult mission, but it turned out that it was just to clear out a bunch of small fries. To think that a few Calamity Grade Supers would be involved in such a small matter. He felt that the main goal of the Amethyst Civilization was to select some new private armed organizations for cooperation.

Ding!

A notification popped up on the interface.

You have triggered the mission [Amethyst Civilization's Warning]!

Han Xiao glanced at it casually and skipped over the experience reward. A reward of more than a million Enas was nothing to him at the moment.

The only reward that he felt was worth 330 Faction Contribution Points from the Amethyst Civilization.

The higher the level of the faction, the harder it was to farm Favorability. However, because of Han Xiao's many Star System Legendary Points, his current relationship with the Amethyst Civilization was not [Cold] but [Neutral]. His initial Faction Favorability was 450 points.

If he wanted Cutting-Edge Knowledge, farming Faction Favorability was the most feasible way.

At this moment, Dottle suddenly thought of something.

"By the way, there's one more thing. The Star System Civilization in charge of the Thousand Lights Star System requested assistance from Purple Crystal a while ago. One of their top combatants went missing, and they requested our help to find him. The missing person is called Kernid, nicknamed Dark Purple Warlock. This is what he looks like … If you find any clues, remember to tell me."

Han Xiao was stunned and felt that the name sounded familiar.

Kernid … seems to be a name on the hunting list.

With a thought, Han Xiao made a mental note of this.

…

Thousand Lights Star System, Star Zone 9.

The target of the joint operation, a fleet disguised as interstellar travelers, was slowly moving through the universe.

In the command room of the main ship, Captain Bredt was recording data.

"Voyage log k- 003015: It has been one hundred and thirty-four days since we entered the Colton Star Cluster. Everything is normal. Sixth intelligence collection in progress. Current reconnaissance area is the Thousand Lights Star System. Civilization development, colony planet ecology, garrison situation, and other data have been packaged and transmitted. Next stop is to head to the core area of the Colton Star Cluster, the White Top Star System, to investigate the Amethyst Civilization."

After the voyage log was sent out, the system completely destroyed the data.

Bredt rubbed his eyes to relieve his fatigue.

"Warning! Warning! Unknown fleet approaching! "

At this moment, the lights in the room turned into a blinding red. The alarm of the spaceship's AI rang, and Bredt immediately came to his senses. He rushed to the front of the radar screen and saw an unknown fleet heading straight for them, about to enter their field of vision.

"Send a message to the other party and ask for their identity. Tell them we're just interstellar travelers."

Bredt shouted.

However, the message was like a stone sinking into the ocean. There was no reply.

Very soon, the attacking fleet appeared and opened fire at Bredt's fleet without saying a word. The battle erupted!

"The enemy isn't a galactic pirate. We've been targeted!" Bredt's face darkened. He was very experienced and immediately understood that they were in deep trouble this time.

Bredt immediately made a decision. While shouting to counterattack, he recorded a video and sent it back to the organization to let the headquarters know who the enemy was.

This attacking fleet was Han Xiao's group. Jayne and Gadeli were commanding the fleet to fight the enemy. All kinds of lights flashed, and the Blacklight Stealth was idling by the side.

In the cockpit, Han Xiao narrowed his eyes as he observed the battlefield.

"Although the enemy isn't much of a threat, it's a good opportunity to test out my new weapon."

As he spoke, Han Xiao switched to autopilot mode, came to the launch port at the belly of the cabin, and jumped into the universe with the Berserk Ape mechanical suit.

The mechanical suit was isolated from the universe environment. Compared to the battleship, Han Xiao's size was like an ant compared to an elephant. However, the next moment, Mechanical Force flashed, and countless mechanical components extended out from the interior of the Berserk Ape mechanical suit.

In the blink of an eye, a thirty-to-forty-meter-tall Giant Soldier mechanical suit was formed. Its size was not inferior to a small assault ship, and the huge energy wave made both sides look at it with surprise.

Giant Soldier — Ship Destroyer — Third Generation Improved Version!

In the past two years, Han Xiao had filled in his High-End Knowledge and finally reverse engineered the blueprint of the spaceship, learning how to build a battleship. Based on this technology, he improved the blueprint of the Ship Destroyer that Carroll had given him and enhanced it twice. Compared to the first generation, the third generation Ship Destroyer looked much more beautiful. It went from a cylindrical shape to a human shape with four limbs and a head.

The Giant Soldier mechanical suit was a mechanical weapon designed for galactic combat. Its performance was extremely strong, and with Han Xiao's Mechanical Force bonus, its power was terrifying. Other than Virtual Intrusion, Han Xiao had even more powerful galactic combat methods.

In the cockpit of the Third Generation Ship Destroyer, Han Xiao completed the nerve connection. The giant mechanical suit was like an extension of his arm, and a little mental burden was nothing to an expert of his level. Han Xiao could not help but miss it.

"It's been a long time since I piloted a large mechanical suit. I wonder if I've gotten rusty."

Bredt's eyes widened, and his voice cracked. "It's a Giant Soldier mechanical suit! Focus fire on it! "

Every qualified commander knew the deterrence of a Giant Soldier in a galactic battle. Compared to a cumbersome battleship, the agility of a Giant Soldier mechanical suit was the nightmare of a fleet. Once a Giant Soldier appeared in a galactic battle, it would definitely become the target of focus fire.

Countless laser beams were fired at him, expanding rapidly in his field of vision. Han Xiao's fighting spirit appeared on his face.

With a thought, the three-dimensional maneuvering system of the Third Generation Ship Destroyer was activated. Like a rabbit, it rushed into the barrage of bullets, narrowly dodging the laser beams. Its high-level energy shield blocked the stray bullets.

Han Technician's piloting skills had been honed through countless battles. Only the Giant Soldier mechanical suit could allow him to show his true skills.

The huge mechanical suit moved like a ghost, quickly approaching the enemy fleet.

This time, two huge cannons extended out from the back of the Third Generation Ship Destroyer, placed on both sides of its shoulders, and shot out thick beams of blazing energy, causing the shields of the enemy ships to vibrate.

Immediately after, four giant hovering guards appeared, surrounding the Third Generation Ship Destroyer to defend and counterattack.

The moment Han Xiao took out the Giant Soldier mechanical suit, the focus of the entire battlefield was on him!

After a while, the Third Generation Ship Destroyer finally approached an enemy ship at the edge. The ship's shield blocked him outside. At this time, the space around the Third Generation Ship Destroyer was visually distorted. Han Xiao activated the anti-shield phase cancellation band, and the shield of the enemy ship in front of him suddenly dimmed, flickering, and its defense was greatly reduced.

In the past two years, Han Xiao had not wasted his time. He had spent a lot of experience gambling on blueprints and created countless good things. The Third Generation Ship Destroyer had condensed a lot of technical essence.

The next moment, the Third Generation Ship Destroyer threw out a heat-melting chainsaw and slashed diagonally. Like cutting tofu, it cut the enemy ship in front of it into two halves, and the cut was glowing red.

Time seemed to freeze for a moment.

The next moment, the two halves of the enemy ship exploded into a firework. If it were not for the vacuum environment, the explosion would have been deafening.

The fire was dazzling, and Jayne and Gadeli could not help but twitch their faces.

What was there to compete for? The limelight was still stolen by Black Star. How could their performance be more dazzling than this Giant Soldier mechanical suit?

Black Star did not bring any troops. He was really enough alone.

"How much did this Giant Soldier cost …" Jayne murmured.
